name: affiliate-product-discovery
description: §18.2 Product Discovery: source stubs → dedup → §5 compliance pre-filter → DISCOVERED → forwards to verification.

nodes.name: webhook-entry
nodes.notes: Entry: POST {triggeredBy?, date?} with x-n8n-secret header.

nodes.name: fetch-sources
nodes.notes: Source stubs (§3). STUB candidates are intentionally empty — the system never invents products. Plug real permitted feeds/APIs here.

nodes.name: dedup-filter
nodes.notes: Dedup + §5 compliance pre-filter. Business states (§19): DISCOVERED → VERIFIED → SCRIPTED → ASSETS_READY → RENDERED → QC_APPROVED → LISTED → PUBLISHED → ANALYZED, plus FAILED | REJECTED | NEEDS_REVIEW. Persistence TODO (no /api/v1/products endpoint).

nodes.name: has-products
nodes.notes: True: forward new products to verification. False: log and stop.

nodes.name: log-empty
nodes.notes: Logs empty runs — never silently dropped.

parameters.jsCode: console.log('[discovery] no new products'); return [{ json: { ok: True, found: 0 } }];

nodes.name: season-rank
nodes.notes: Season-aware ranking (digital technique): seasonal products +25, never a veto.

nodes.name: apply-ranking
nodes.notes: Applies the ranked order, or keeps the dedup order when ranking failed.
